posts.t: Catching up, Caps coach Spencer Carbery said Logan Thompson (lower body) remains day-to-day and they'll see how he feels tomorrow. Pierre-Luc Dubois and Justin Sourdif went through full practice and Carbery will talk to trainer Jason Serbus to determine their availabity vs. Buffalo on Saturday.
No Logan Thompson (lower body) at Capitals practice again today. Pierre-Luc Dubois (illness) and Justin Sourdif (illness) are both practicing in regular jerseys.

A positive update on Pierre-Luc Dubois as he's back at the facility (and was set to skate Saturday), Justin Sourdif will sit due to illness, PLD and Matt Roy remain out and more notes as the Capitals host the Devils.
